about_the_game:
In Ayana, you shape your world by strategically placing tiles to create your town map, making choices that directly influence your floral business. Success begins with preparation: use daily bouquet forecasts to plan your inventory and stock up on supplies from the visiting merchant. Before the shop opens, you must manage your limited energy to either add daily powers or get a head start by pre-crafting bouquets. When customers arrive, speed is key as you craft stunning bouquets with a single click and serve them before their patience runs out. Every action impacts your growing reputation, which you must carefully maintain to avoid a game over, ultimately challenging you to serve the main boss and reach the top score in this strategic simulator.

Key Features:

Tile-Based Map Building: Strategically place tiles to create your town map.

Forecast-Driven Planning: Use daily trends to plan your inventory.

Merchant Mechanics: Purchase supplies from a visiting merchant once per day.

Morning Preparation: Use limited energy to add daily powers or pre-craft bouquets.

Customer Service: Serve bouquets quickly before patience runs out.

Reputation System: Manage your actions to keep your business running and avoid a game over.

Boss Encounters: Serve the main boss to achieve the top score.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.15 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-capable GPU running Vulkan via MoltenVK
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 10.15 or newer
  • Processor: Apple M1/M2 or Intel Core i7
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Recent Metal-capable GPU (runs Vulkan via MoltenVK)
  • Storage: 2 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any

  • Processor: Dual-core 64-bit CPU
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM

  • Processor: Quad-core CPU
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Mid-range GPU with Vulkan 1.x support

short_description: Step into Ayana, a cozy flower shop simulator where strategy impacts success. Build your town map, plan inventory using forecasts, and craft bouquets for customers. Manage your actions and energy to grow your reputation, serve the boss, and reach the top score.
